description: Pins the cluster_id rejections and the single GET. cluster_id is an integer path param, and proto3 collapses an absent one onto zero, so absent, zero, and negative all answer the positive-integer sentence.

cases.name: rejects missing cluster_id
cases.expect_error: cluster_id must be a positive integer

cases.name: rejects a non-positive cluster_id
cases.expect_error: cluster_id must be a positive integer

cases.name: rejects a negative cluster_id
cases.expect_error: cluster_id must be a positive integer
